title: Next Gen High Pressure Cold Spray System
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8132  AFSC PZIMC
description_text: NEXT GEN HIGH PRESSURE COLD SPRAY SYSTEM: consisting of the following equipment - - Impact Innovation EvoCSII Cold Spray Machine – [BRAND NAME] configured for Helium & Nitrogen Carrier Gas and Mutli-Gas Sprays; equipped with nozzle cooling, powder feeder station configured for 2 powder feeders, and 2 powder feeders; EvoCSII 6/11 AH Cold Spray Gun; includes all additional tools listed in Appendix A of the Statement of Work (SOW). See SOW for machine details. - Fanuc M-710iC/50 Industrial Robot – [BRAND NAME] delivered with all options listed in the SOW. - Nitrogen Supply System – capacity sufficient to meet gas consumption on 4-6 week refill schedule; compressor sized to produce 3600psig; gas provided at 99.999% purity; configured for outdoor service; configured with capacity telemetry to schedule delivery; foundation assessment (new foundation, if required); see SOW for details. - Argon Fire Suppression System – meets requirements set in NFPA 484 and NFPA 2001. See SOW for details. - HiWatch HR2 Particle Measurement System – [BRAND NAME] with sensor. See SOW for details. - ReliaCoat In-Situ Coating Property (ICP-8) Sensor – [BRAND NAME] see SOW for details. - Dust Handler/Collector – with spark arrester and blast venting. See SOW for details. - High-Pressure Gas Plumbing – see SOW for details. - Ancillary Equipment – all additional items and components included as listed in SOW - System Integration – as outlined in SOW. - Installation – see SOW for details. - Training – see SOW for details. All details are listed in the Statement of Work (SOW). This is a Brand Name Requirement for four of the system components IAW RFO FAR Subpart 11.204 and the authority found at RFO FAR 12.201-1, Simplified Procedures (41 USC 1901). We are requesting quotes for the exact item(s) found in the Quote Sheet and the attachments. Please see Quote Sheet and the attachments for complete details. Substitute/Equal items are not permitted in quotes for this solicitation. Quotes with Substitute/Equal items will not be eligible for award.
